This is scoped evidence, not full current 482-case acceptance or JavaScript/React/1Password proof. Pending explicit paste has precedence over current connected DOM. Locale protects adopted control/intent state only; unfocused unadopted DOM may reset. Independent before-state oracles observe actual token/refs/POST records; no server accepts every nonempty label. Mutation sensitivity requires real noninitial named TLC counterexamples, not static anchor counts. Generated app.js scope is ONLY the compiled login-input intent projection. The local offline rebuild of source bd135b55c79b14239130dba8b4f6ca246367b5c5 produced asset commit 5219eb1349e597306b2ef125ebf41e76188908d9 with 1353 resolved inputs and retained original notices for 22 packages; exact asset digests and input metadata are committed under tools/console. Default hosted-CI build equivalence remains to be checked. Compiler/minifier correctness, React/DOM/native input APIs and backend behavior are not refinement-proved; this binding does not prove the rest of the bundle. The focus scenario explicitly assumes a possible controlled render after focus capture resets DOM from adopted controlled state. This explores a suspected ordering hazard, not an established explanation of the actual CI response timeout. The full current 482-case gate and real Dia/1Password acceptance remain unverified. It explicitly assumes a possible controlled render after key capture resets DOM from the adopted token, without establishing the actual browser failure cause. Current-key pending-paste ordering is not covered by this additional scenario. The eight invariants protect bounded token/intent/POST safety; they do not establish empty-error DOM visibility. The unchanged empty-error and no-POST browser assertions remain separate required acceptance checks. Scoped 15-case success does not replace the pending current 482-case combined gate or the unchanged actual native-clear/Enter browser assertions. Integration with main catalog models requires a new immutable 53-model/429-control/482-case gate; historical scoped Login results do not establish that combined gate. On old-base head 8149cac, both complete 62-case browser suites passed the native-clear/Enter empty-error and no-POST checks. That historical success is not acceptance of this combined main-catalog tree, whose 65-case E2E and 482-case formal gates still require fresh immutable-HEAD verification.
